password_manager.how: Install one, import what your browser saved, then move email and bank first. Others follow as you log in.

manager_report.how: Bitwarden: Reports → Vault health reports. 1Password: Watchtower. Proton Pass: Pass Monitor. Fix breached and reused entries first.

browser_password_check.how: Chrome: Password Manager → Checkup. Safari or iCloud Keychain: Passwords app → Security. Fix what's flagged as compromised or reused.

unique_passwords.how: Generate a new random password for your main email, then your bank, in your password manager. Email first: it resets the rest.

email_second_factor.how: On the security page, add a passkey or an authenticator app. Save the backup codes it offers (see backup_codes).

email_no_sms.how: Once an app or passkey works, make it the default and remove text messages as a sign-in option where the provider allows.

email_recovery.how: Remove recovery numbers and addresses you no longer control. Keep at least one current one.

other_email_accounts.how: Repeat the second factor and recovery check on each other account. Work accounts: follow your employer's setup.

security_key.how: Buy two FIDO2 keys (one spare). Register both on your main email, then other important accounts.

carrier_pin.how: In your carrier's app or by phone, ask for a number-transfer or port-out PIN. Store it in your password manager.

phone.ios: Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic Updates: turn everything on.
phone.android: Settings → System → Software updates (names vary by maker): turn on automatic updates. Also Play Store → Settings → Auto-update apps.

computer.macos: System Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic updates: turn everything on.
computer.windows: Settings → Windows Update → Advanced options: turn on getting updates as soon as they're available.
computer.linux: Turn on unattended upgrades (Debian/Ubuntu) or dnf-automatic (Fedora). Needs admin rights, so the user runs it.

phone.ios: Settings → Face ID & Passcode (or Touch ID & Passcode): set a passcode of 6+ digits, then Settings → Display & Brightness → Auto-Lock: 1 minute.
phone.android: Settings → Security (or Security & privacy) → Screen lock: set a PIN or password, then add fingerprint or face unlock.

computer.macos: System Settings → Lock Screen: require password immediately after sleep or screen saver.
computer.windows: Settings → Accounts → Sign-in options: set up Windows Hello, and require sign-in when you've been away.
computer.linux: Settings → Privacy → Screen Lock: turn on automatic screen lock.

connected_apps.how: Remove anything you don't recognise or no longer use. Keep what you use weekly.

lockdown_mode.how: Only for people likely to be targeted (journalists, activists, public figures). It breaks some features.

phone.android: Android 16 and later: Settings → Security & privacy → Advanced Protection.

computer.macos: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Lockdown Mode.

breach_check.how: Search each email address. For every breached site still in use, change that password.

breach_alerts.how: Sign up with your main email address. Alerts come by email.

people_search_removal.how: By hand: search your name on the big people-search sites and use each opt-out form. Or pay a removal service to repeat it.

gdpr_erasure.how: Fill in the letter, then send it to each broker yourself. They have one month to reply.

google_results.how: Sign in, add your phone, address and email, and request removal of results that show them.

credit_freeze.how: Freeze at Equifax, Experian and TransUnion, one at a time. Save each PIN or login in your password manager.

transaction_alerts.how: In your banking app, turn on a notification for every card payment and transfer.

bank_voice_id_off.how: Call the number on your card. Say: "Please remove voice ID from my account and use a PIN or app approval instead."

bank_sign_in.how: In your bank's app or website security settings, switch sign-in approval from text codes to the app or a passkey.

phone.android: Phone app → Settings → Voicemail → Greeting (varies by carrier): pick the default.

voice_inventory.how: List every place your voice is public: videos, podcasts, talks, social posts, voice notes in public groups.

voice_audience.how: Go through the list and set each item to private, friends only, or delete it if it isn't needed.

youtube_likeness.how: In YouTube Studio, find likeness detection under content detection. It needs ID and a selfie.

likeness_monitoring.how: Create an account and add reference photos. It alerts you when your face shows up elsewhere.

safe_word.how: Pick a word no one could guess from social media. Share it in person or by call, not in a group chat.

callback_rule.how: Agree: any money request by phone gets a hang-up and a call back on a saved number.

brief_relatives.how: A short call works best. Cover the safe word and the callback rule.

training_off_chatgpt.how: Settings → Data controls → Improve the model for everyone: off.

training_off_claude.how: Settings → Privacy → Help improve Claude: off.

activity_off_gemini.how: On the Gemini activity page, turn activity saving off. Delete past activity if you want.

training_off_copilot.how: Profile → Privacy → Model training on text: off. Also voice, if shown.

meta_ai_settings.how: In the Privacy Center, find AI at Meta. In the EU or UK, submit the objection form. Elsewhere, make posts you don't want used private.

training_off_linkedin.how: Settings → Data privacy → Data for Generative AI Improvement: off.

training_off_github.how: Settings → Copilot: turn off allowing GitHub to use your data for product improvements and training.

assistant_memory.how: Open each assistant's memory or personalization settings. Delete anything you wouldn't want stored: health, money, other people.

agent_inventory.review: Run the check, then go through each tool with the user: what can it read, run, send or buy? Note anything they didn't know about.

agent_confirm.how: Keep approval prompts on for sending, paying and running commands. Avoid modes that skip all permission prompts.
agent_confirm.review: Run the check and point out any permissive mode or long allow list. Changing a tool's config file needs the user's OK on the exact change and a backup first.

agent_revoke.how: Remove connected tools and account connections that haven't been used in a month.
agent_revoke.review: Run the check and go through the connected tools by name. Remove only what the user picks; back up the config file first.

agent_banking.how: Use a separate browser profile for banking and never let an agent browse in it.

backup_codes.how: Download or print backup codes for your main email. Keep them on paper or offline, away from your phone.

fraud_reporting.how: Save the link as a bookmark, plus your bank's fraud phone number in your contacts.

deepfake_takedown.how: StopNCII makes a fingerprint of the image on your device so platforms can block it. The image itself isn't uploaded.
